_comment: ngsolve dg_methods#5 (at Pe>>1 upwind DG is stable but the SIP diffusion penalty is still required). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: unit square, b=(1,0), eps=0.01, unit source, homogeneous Dirichlet everywhere, ONE mesh at maxh 0.15 (cell Peclet 7.5) shared by all three discretisations, order 1. A non-negative source with zero boundary data has a non-negative solution, so any negative value is an artefact -- no reference solution needed. H1 Galerkin undershoots to -0.0348; upwind DG with the penalty stays non-negative (min +0.00054), which confirms the claim's first half. CORRECTION: with alpha=0 the DG field is not 'small-amplitude ringing' -- it undershoots to -7.36, 5.7 times the penalised field's own positive peak. An agent looking for a small ripple can accept a completely wrong field. Mutation: leaving the penalty on in the alpha=0 branch removes the undershoot and the fixture fails on dg_alpha0_goes_negative and alpha0_is_not_small_amplitude_ringing.
